text:
Nina: Quick heads-up 1 auklet-v1 int8 onboarding shows locale drift: CJK subtoken boundaries moved and RTL bracket flip on Arabic samples. sharing minimal repro and numbers.
Hao: drop a failing example?
Nina: repro:
Nina: zh input: "評価資料(書)"
Nina: auklet-v1 int8 detok: "評価 資料書 )"  <-- extra space + trailing bracket mirrored on some RTLs
Tanya: metrics quick: WMT-zh-en BLEU -0.6 on shortctx shard; chrF -1.9; embed drift ~-0.07 cosine vs fp16 baseline
Greg: token id diff (excerpt):
```
- ... 501, 4102, 77, 900
+ ... 501, 41, 0277, 900
```
Nina: looks like a split/merge around vocab block 4000-4300
Hao: repro command: `python -m eval.run --model auklet-v1 --quant int8 --samples tests/locale/auklet_samples.json --detok strict`
Hao: I reproduced locally; aligns with recent change that reordered tokenizer precompile (commit e7a4b1c)
Tanya: important: fp16->int8 shows same pattern when precompile ordering applied, so quantization magnifies symptom but isn't root cause
Eval-bot: CI guardrail: 10/1800 failing (0.56%) > threshold 0.25% concentrated on CJK short and JP-kana mix
Nina: short-term band-aid: post-detok normalize CJK punctuation spacing and force unicode fullwidth brackets for RTL outputs
Nina: tiny patch I tried: `s = re.sub(r'([一-鿿])([()])', r'\1 \2', s); if is_rtl(s): s = s.replace('(', '\\uff08').replace(')', '\\uff09')`
Greg: acceptable temporarily but we need a deterministic fix. can someone run git-bisect with e7a4b1c as first-bad?
Hao: starting bisect now 1 will test tokenmap-only rollback then kernel pin combos
Tanya: plan: (1) bisect to identify commit(s), (2) run full eval matrix (50k) with tokenmap rollback x runtime pins, (3) add unit tests to tests/locale/auklet_edgecases.json for the exact patterns, (4) revert or patch precompile to deterministic ordering
Nina: adding test vectors auklet_zh_jp_brackets.json and auklet_ar_bracket_flip.json
Eval-bot: scheduled full run 3192001800 (50k samples) to collect delta matrix
Greg: FYI Dedicated customers may be pinned to older runtimes; flagging @eng-runtime and @oncall in case we need coordinated rollback window
Nina: I'll open PR with the post-detok mitigation + unit tests and attach bisect notes when done. tagging @eng-ml-leads.
Hao: update incoming in this thread once bisect finishes.
Nina: thanks all :thumbsup:
